### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Full Stack Engineer building scalable web applications for Evolve, a vacation-rental company. Delivering React and TypeScript solutions across custom development projects.
Senior Full Stack Engineer building vacation-rental web applications for Evolve
Role description:
• Build and maintain TypeScript-driven web applications using in-house and open-source frameworks
• Collaborate across teams to design, develop, test, implement, and support full-stack technical solutions
• Use React, NodeJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML/CSS, GraphQL, Go, SQL, RDBMS and NoSQL databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS tools and services
• Perform code reviews and technical documentation for peers
• Work directly with a Product Manager/Product Owner to understand problems being solved
• Design, deliver, and support high-quality code
• Execute engineering and release priorities
• Build and maintain a component library
• Drive collaboration on JavaScript coding standards, best practices, integrations, and front-end/back-end development processes
• Guide and teach less experienced developers
Role requirements:
• 5+ years of experience developing web applications in React with expertise in JavaScript
• Design and develop robust and scalable APIs using GraphQL and RESTful principles
• Familiarity with Go language, frameworks and libraries for building services
• Utilize AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development and reduce errors
• Comfortable working with DevOps teams to optimize CI/CD pipelines
• Experience participating in and/or peer code reviews
• Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-performance environments
• Strong debugging skills and ability to find solutions to problems
• Experience building custom tools to automate tasks
• Experience with Git version control and repository management in GitLab
• Experience with Content Management Systems such as WordPress

• Pet insurance

• RTO for full-time exempt employees
• Sick leave
• Holidays

• Annual Evolve travel credit after one year
• Discounts on stays at all Evolve properties
• World-class onboarding programs
• Learning and development resources
• Employee Resource Groups

AWS, Docker, GraphQL, JavaScript, Kubernetes, Node.js, NoSQL, RDBMS, React, SQL, TypeScript, WordPress, Go
